title: The Euro Currency entered circulation in the digital transaction in the European Union (EU) Eurozone member area countries.
text: The euro is the official currency of 21 of the 27 member states of the European Union. This group of states is officially known as the euro area, more commonly named the eurozone.

title: 4 July –The 1999 IFAF World Cup is held in Palermo.
text: The 1999 IFAF World Championship was the inaugural IFAF World Championship, an international American football championship run by the International Federation of American Football. It was played in Palermo, Italy from 24 June to 4 July 1999.

title: 1-11 September – 56th Venice International Film Festival
text: The 56th annual Venice International Film Festival was held between 1 and 11 September 1999. Stanley Kubrick's final film Eyes Wide Shut was the festival's opening film.

title: 1999 IAAF World Half Marathon Championships
text: The 8th IAAF World Half Marathon Championships was held on October 3, 1999, in the city of Palermo, Italy. A total of 192 athletes, 119 men and 73 women, from 48 countries, took part.

title: 1999 ICF Canoe Sprint World Championships
text: The 1999 ICF Canoe Sprint World Championships were held in Milan, Italy at the Idroscalo. The men's competition consisted of nine Canadian and nine kayak events.

title: 1999 UCI Road World Championships
text: The 1999 UCI Road World Championships took place in Treviso and Verona, Italy, between October 3 and October 10, 1999. The event consisted of a road race and a time trial for men, women, men under 23, junior men and junior women.

title: 1999 Women's European Volleyball Championship
text: The 1999 Women's European Volleyball Championship was the 21st edition of the event, organised by Europe's governing volleyball body, the Confédération Européenne de Volleyball. It was hosted in Rome and Perugia, Italy from 20 to 25 September 1999.

title: 1999 Women's European Water Polo Championship
text: The 1999 Women's European Water Polo Championship was the eighth edition of the bi-annual event, organised by the Europe's governing body in aquatics, the Ligue Européenne de Natation. The event took place in Prato, Italy from September 4 to September 11, 1999.

title: 1999 Men's European Water Polo Championship
text: The 1999 Men's European Water Polo Championship took place in Florence, Italy from September 2 to September 11, 1999. It was organised by the Ligue Européenne de Natation.

title: “Believe” by Cher
text: "Believe" is a song by the American singer Cher from her 22nd studio album, Believe. It was released as the lead single on October 19, 1998, by Warner Bros.

title: “Pretty Fly (For a White Guy)” by The Offspring
text: "Pretty Fly" is a song by American rock band the Offspring. It is the fourth track from the band's fifth studio album, Americana (1998), and was released as its first single in November 1998.

title: “Oggi sono io” by Alex Britti
text: "Oggi sono io" is a song written and recorded by Italian singer Alex Britti. With this song, he won the 49th Italian Song Festival in 1999 in the category "newcomers".

title: “...Baby One More Time” by Britney Spears
text: "...Baby One More Time" is the debut single by the American singer Britney Spears, from her 1999 debut album of the same name. It was written by Max Martin and produced by Martin and Rami Yacoub.

title: “Snow on the Sahara” by Anggun
text: "Snow on the Sahara" is a song recorded by Indonesian singer Anggun for her first international studio album Snow on the Sahara (1997). Originally written in French by its producer Erick Benzi, the song was adapted to English by Nikki Matheson.

title: “Flat Beat” by Mr. Oizo
text: "Flat Beat" is an instrumental by French musician Mr. Oizo.

title: “Per te” by Jovanotti
text: Lorenzo 1999 – Capo Horn is the eighth studio album by Italian singer-songwriter Jovanotti, released by Mercury Records on 10 May 1999.

title: “I Want It That Way” by Backstreet Boys
text: "I Want It That Way" is a song by American boy band Backstreet Boys. It was released on April 12, 1999, as the lead single from their third studio album, Millennium.
listen: I Want It That Way Backstreet Boys

title: “Beautiful Stranger” by Madonna
text: "Beautiful Stranger" is a song by American singer and songwriter Madonna. It was released on May 19, 1999, by Maverick and Warner Bros.

title: “Unforgivable Sinner” by Lene Marlin
text: "Unforgivable Sinner" is a song written and performed by Norwegian singer-songwriter Lene Marlin, released as her debut single on 12 October 1998 from her first album, Playing My Game. The song reached number one in Norway and number two in Italy, commencing a successful period of hits for Marlin in both countries.

title: “Il mio nome è mai più” by Liga-Jova-Pelù
text: Luciano Riccardo Ligabue, commonly known as Ligabue or Liga, is an Italian singer-songwriter, film director, and writer.
listen: Il mio nome è mai più Liga-Jova-Pelù

title: “New Day” by Wyclef Jean featuring Bono
text: "New Day" is a charity single released by Haitian rapper Wyclef Jean and Irish singer-songwriter Bono, in aid of charity NetAid. The song appears on the international version of Jean's second album, The Ecleftic: 2 Sides II a Book.
listen: New Day Wyclef Jean featuring Bono

title: “50 special” by Lùnapop
text: Lùnapop was an Italian pop rock music group active between 1999 and 2001. Lùnapop released its lone full length Italian language album, ...Squérez?, in 1999.

title: “Keep On Movin'” by Five
text: "Keep On Movin'" is a song by British boy band Five. It was released on 25 October 1999 by RCA and BMG as the second single from their second studio album, Invincible.

title: “La fine del millennio” by Vasco Rossi
text: Vasco Rossi, also known mononymously as Vasco or with the nickname Il Blasco, is an Italian singer-songwriter and poet. He has published 30 albums (not including unofficial releases) and written over 250 songs, as well as lyrics for other artists.
